questions.prompt: Which of these live in the ocean their whole lives?
questions.fact: Salmon spawn in rivers, sea turtles lay their eggs on beaches and penguins breed on land. None of them spends a whole life at sea.

questions.prompt: Which of these were presidents of the United States?
questions.fact: Benjamin Franklin, Alexander Hamilton and Aaron Burr never held the office. Burr shot Hamilton dead in a duel.

questions.prompt: How many minutes does a football (soccer) match last, not counting added time?
questions.fact: 90 minutes: two halves of 45, plus whatever the referee adds for stoppages.

questions.prompt: How hot is the surface of the Sun, in degrees Celsius?
questions.fact: About 5,500 degrees at the surface, and around 15 million at the core.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a prime number?
questions.hint: A prime has no factors but itself and one. Try dividing each by three.
questions.fact: A prime divides by nothing but itself and one. 29 is the only one here that manages it.

questions.prompt: Which artist cut off part of his own ear?
questions.hint: He painted a night sky full of swirling stars.
questions.fact: He painted himself afterwards with the bandage on, and sold almost nothing in his lifetime.
